basis.governing_question: Should Quinta Azul enter the retail markets of Spain, France, Germany and Poland, and in which order?

sub_questions.question: How attractive is the retail market in each of Spain, France, Germany and Poland?
What does Quinta Azul need to compete in each, given competitors, buyers and regulation?
Is entry a go or no-go in each of the four countries, and through which entry option?
In what order, and with what plan, should Quinta Azul enter the countries that are a go?

drivers.evidence: retail markets of Spain, France, Germany and Poland

work.unit: Market assessed in full (demand, channels, competitors, regulation, buyer interviews)

phase_work.why: Four markets screened at once on desk data, three assessed in full two at a time; the second round pushes the max past 8 weeks.

work.unit: Entry option and business case for one market
Entry sequence and roadmap across markets

phase_work.why: Business cases for three markets two at a time, then one sequence and roadmap; the second round pushes the max past 6 weeks.

sizing.levers: Dropping to a two-country shortlist after the desk screen, or running all shortlisted assessments side by side, would each cut about 3 to 5 weeks.

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Establish how attractive each of the four retail markets is and what Quinta Azul would need to compete there.

gate.label: Shortlist decision
gate.decision: Which countries move forward to entry options and business cases?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define go or no-go for each country, plus the entry sequence and plan for those that are a go.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the go or no-go per country and the entry sequence and plan?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given, so the 13 to 15 weeks are an estimate from the work and must be confirmed before quoting.
Research and Design take the middle of 7 to 10 and 4 to 7 weeks; slow buyer access would push them to the top.
The plan assumes the desk screen shortlists three of four countries; a shortlist of two would cut about 3 to 5 weeks.
